articles.title: Serbia's Vučić concedes election defeat to student-led protest movement
articles.description: The country's populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his Serbian Progressive Party has lost.

articles.title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
articles.description: The Israeli Defense Forces announces restrictions on the movement of Palestinian workers in the run-up to Tuesday's election.

articles.title: Obama attacks Trump as he campaigns for Democrats ahead of midterm elections
articles.description: Obama said the election was "the last best chance to at least rein in some of the foolishness of this administration".

articles.title: Australian MP's condition improves after alleged car attack
articles.description: The independent MP is now in a serious but stable condition, according to the Melbourne hospital.

articles.title: Three released without charge after fatal arson attack in Ireland
articles.description: Three people - two women and one man - have been released, and one person remains in custody, gardaí say.

articles.title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election
articles.description: The Student List has emerged from almost two years of anti-corruption protests to form the biggest challenge to Vučić's rule.

articles.title: White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom
articles.description: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.

articles.title: Pro-Russian Serbian leader concedes election defeat to student protesters
articles.description: Serbia's long-serving leader has conceded defeat to a student-led movement in the country's parliamentary election.

articles.title: British and French paratroopers take part in major wargame in Germany
articles.description: Over 2,500 British and French troops have taken part in a wargame in Germany designed to show how NATO territory could be defended against an attack.
